headline: UBS SLASHES 2026 Gold Target to $5,500/oz — Cites Opportunity Cost as Yields Stay High
snippet: Swiss bank UBS cut its year-end 2026 gold forecast from $5,900 to $5,500/oz, citing elevated Treasury yields and sustained USD strength. Gold futures shed $54 on May 27 — the steepest single-session drop of the month — as investors weigh the opportunity cost of non-yielding assets at $4,457/oz.

headline: CHINA ADDS 60,000 Gold Ounces to Reserves in May — Central Banks Still Buying at Record Pace
snippet: The People's Bank of China added roughly 60,000 ounces to its official gold reserves in May, extending a multi-year accumulation streak. A weekly Gold SWOT report notes that 95% of global central bankers expect official reserves to grow, with a record 43% planning active increases in the next 12 months.

headline: COPPER TARIFF TRADE IS BACK — Traders Scouring Globe for Metal to Ship to US Before June Report
snippet: Copper traders are again flooding US warehouses as the Comex-LME premium reopens, with imports forecast to rebound to 150,000–200,000 tonnes a month. The US Commerce Department must deliver a tariff recommendation by June 30, potentially triggering a 15% duty from January 2027 that would squeeze global LME inventories.

headline: SQM DOUBLES QUARTERLY EBITDA, Raises Lithium Sales Guidance as Supply Tightens
snippet: Chilean lithium major SQM reported Q1 2026 EBITDA more than double the year-ago quarter and upgraded its full-year sales volume outlook, citing market tightening following China's VAT rebate rollback on battery exports effective April 1. The beat signals improving fundamentals across the battery supply chain after years of oversupply.

headline: MARYLAND REVERSES COURSE: State Restores Gold & Silver Sales Tax Exemption — Effective July 1
snippet: Maryland Governor Wes Moore signed legislation on May 26 restoring the state's sales tax exemption on purchases of gold and silver bullion coins, bars, and rounds — reversing a controversial 2025 tax that drew backlash from dealers and collectors. The exemption takes effect July 1, 2026, and joins a growing list of states protecting precious metals buyers from sales tax.

headline: ATHABASCA DRILLING STARTS: F4 Uranium Kicks Off 2,500m Murphy Lake Program With UraniumX
snippet: F4 Uranium Corp (TSXV: FFU) and partner UraniumX Discovery Corp have commenced a ~2,500-metre drill program at the Murphy Lake Property in Saskatchewan's Athabasca Basin, targeting a uranium system flagged by strong geochemistry and anomalous radioactivity in 2022 maiden drilling. The ~$2M program is fully funded by UraniumX under the existing option agreement.

headline: Newmont vs. SSR Mining: Which Is the Better Gold Stock to Own Right Now?
snippet: A fresh head-to-head pits Newmont's scale and record $3.3 billion Q1 net income against SSR Mining's lower valuation and recovery potential following operational setbacks. The analysis asks which offers better risk-adjusted exposure for investors who want a gold miner, not just the metal, at current spot prices above $4,400.

headline: USA RARE EARTH Has Millionaire-Maker Potential — But Execution Risk Remains Real
snippet: USA Rare Earth (USAR) is racing to become the first US 'mine-to-magnet' business, with its Round Top polymetallic deposit in Texas and a magnet factory in Oklahoma targeting the supply chain that China currently dominates. Analysts see significant upside if the company executes, but warn that commercial-scale production has yet to be demonstrated.

headline: SILVER DEFICIT ENTERS YEAR SIX at $84 — Analysts Say Stop Chasing Price, Watch the Drawdown
snippet: Silver briefly cleared $87 after the May 10 US-China tariff truce before pulling back to the low $80s — a volatile range that masks a structural supply deficit now entering its sixth consecutive year, with nearly 762 million cumulative ounces drawn from inventories. Analysts argue the real trade is in the deepening physical tightness, not the near-term price level.

headline: Magna Mining Posts Positive Q1 Cash Margin at Sudbury Copper-Nickel Mine
snippet: Magna Mining (TSXV: NICU) reported a Q1 2026 cash margin of $6.0 million at its McCreedy West copper-precious metals-nickel mine in Ontario's Sudbury camp. Management held an earnings call May 28 to discuss operational performance, with base metals pricing providing a tailwind for the junior producer.
